title: Hearty Scottish Puy Lentils Cottage Pie
description: A nutty and molten Scottish dish featuring puy lentils, perfect for a post-workout meal, baked to perfection in a wood-fired oven and served in a lazy Susan spinner.
instructions: Preheat the wood-fired oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large pot, bring the puy lentils and 2 cups of water to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes.
In a large pan, cook the ground beef over medium-high heat until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the chopped onion, carrots, and potatoes to the pan and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Stir in the tomato paste, olive oil, salt, and pepper.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked lentils and the meat and vegetable mixture.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with additional chopped potatoes.
Bake the cottage pie in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown.
Remove the pie from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
Serve the cottage pie hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
